message: Google Flow plans the whole video with you before it spends a single credit
source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0vQ7UEe7rLg (Kevin Stratvert, How to Use Google Flow, 2026-07-07)

lines.text: Google Flow is now a full AI film studio, but most people still type one prompt into it and hope for the best.
Start a new project at flow dot google, and before it makes anything, Flow asks you about the vibe, the hero shot and the style.
Then it writes the whole storyboard, with characters, camera angles and dialogue. Editing that text costs zero credits, so fix everything here.
When the storyboard looks right, it generates every clip at once. Six shots cost ninety credits, and they actually look like one film.
Create a character once, tag it with the at sign, and it stays the same person in every shot. You can even turn yourself into one.
Then drop the clips on the timeline, trim them and export. Save this, and try it before you make your next video.
